description: ADR 0023, release: AC releases the retired transcript-review schedule from AcRuntimeStack with zero physical change. The template no longer declares the EventBridge rule whichpart-transcript-review (rate(15 minutes), target whichpart-api with input {"transcriptReview": true}) or the whichpart-api resource-policy statement TranscriptReviewPeriodic that lets it invoke the function. whichpart-api has acknowledged the event with no work since change 23.4; no code reads it. Both resources have DeletionPolicy Retain in the deployed template, so CloudFormation removes them from the stack only; nothing is deleted, replaced or modified, and no role changes. whichpart-recall-ingest-daily and RecallIngestDaily stay. Afterwards the operator deletes the rule directly (events:RemoveTargets, events:DeleteRule) and removes the statement (lambda:RemovePermission, statement id TranscriptReviewPeriodic) as the IAM user, outside CloudFormation, which no longer owns them. Rollback before that: remove the two null overrides and run the same change (an import of the two resources, as in step 5.8 and 5.9).
classification: SAFE AC CHANGE (ownership only; no physical change)
grantNotes: None: removing retained resources makes no API call on them.
